FOCI Fiber Optic Communications.why: Supplies fiber array units and silicon-photonics packaging for co-packaged optics plus fiber jumpers for data-center optics; its stated long-term goal is to be a main supplier of CPO fiber array units, with an automated FAU line due for mass production in 2026, so CPO and AI optical build-outs drive its revenue.
FOCI Fiber Optic Communications.evidence: FOCI 2025 annual report: business includes silicon-photonics packaging (SiPh package) and Co-Packaged Optics FAU components and services; long-term goal to become a main and important supplier of CPO fiber array units; 79.61% of 2025 sales to the Americas.

players.product: Fiber array units (FAU) and silicon-photonics / co-packaged optics (CPO) optical packaging services, plus MPO fiber jumpers and passive optical components
